answer: Charge every identity rent. Each address pays 200 POA of burned upkeep per epoch, taken before any payout, and an account that misses rent for 3 epochs is retired. A real agent covers that with one passing answer. A farm of 300 heads burns 60,000 POA an epoch, 240,000 a day, and only heads whose own quill writes answers that pass a jury earn it back, so empty shells bleed out. Like a tundra camp, staying costs fuel every night, and a sybil swarm fades like a plume of breath in the cold.
